svg.title: Skyward Ruins: a custom 600 metre climbing course
svg.desc: Eight districts with a permanent route, optional illusion footholds, launch shafts, birds, hollow soldiers, and a summit finish.

g.text: 600 m climb / 384 objects / 7 shared terrain templates
Green: permanent route. Pink: illusion. Blue arrow: updraft. B / S: enemies.
Recovery landings are not checkpoints. Runtime movement and deaths do not rewrite the level.
Custom layout and artwork. Height is a design target, not a verified measurement of another game.
